name: 1fi-emistore-monorepo
description: Full-stack dynamic product and mutual fund EMI selection platform

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm run install:backend && npm run install:frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend run test && npm --prefix frontend run test
